title: Some Ideas for Update
body:
Great app, helps so mich with tracking my habits🔥 after using for a few days got myself a Premium.

Some things I missed: 

Some sort of Grouping option for my habits. To group them like icons are grouped in "Choose Habit" menu. 

And 3D Touch features in operating with my habits and in the "Add" Icon, on lower bar of the app.

Thank you! 🙏🏽
author: Nozim Mztrkhr
